title: Lemma 3.10: comparison of two p-colimit diagrams
statement_scope: Let gamma': E^> x Delta^1 -> Str^loc_T(X) be a diagram whose two restrictions to E^> are p-colimit diagrams and whose restriction to E x Delta^1 is a left Kan extension. Then: (a) the map E -> E_0 is left cofinal; (b) delta restricted to E is a p-left Kan extension of delta restricted to E_0. The proof forms the Cech nerve V_bullet of an effective epimorphism f: V -> U and concludes via Lemma 3.9.
